common.error: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
common.offline: You're offline. Changes need a connection and were not saved.
common.disclaimer: Sukhi helps you follow a routine you have agreed on. It is not a medical service, does not diagnose, and does not monitor emergencies. In an emergency call 112.

landing.heroTitle: Stay with the plan you and your doctor agreed on.
landing.heroBody: Sukhi reminds you gently, listens in your language, and celebrates every day you show up — including the day you start again.
landing.heroNote: Works in your phone's browser and on WhatsApp. Nothing to install.
landing.demoHint: Tap “I did it” and watch the garden grow.
landing.howIntro: Four small steps, repeated each day. That's the whole idea.
landing.step1Body: Type it in, or photograph what your care team gave you. You check every line before anything is scheduled.
landing.step2Body: At the times you choose, in the app or on WhatsApp — never during your quiet hours.
landing.step3Body: Done, later, skipped or not feeling well. Every honest answer counts. Add a photo if you like.
landing.step4Body: Progress you can see, milestones each week, and a warm welcome back after a break.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to keep going, nothing you don't
landing.f1Body: Ask what's next, talk through a hard day, or send a voice note. Answers come from your own plan, and Sukhi tells you when it doesn't know.
landing.f2Title: Honest about what a photo shows
landing.f2Body: Share a photo of your walk or your meal. Sukhi tells you what it can see and what a photo can't prove. Your own word always counts.
landing.f3Body: Every check-in helps it grow. Missing a day never takes anything away, and coming back earns a little extra.
landing.why1Body: If anything on your prescription is unclear, Sukhi asks you to check it. It never fills in a dose or a time on its own.
landing.why2Body: If you don't reply, we record “no reply”, not a miss. Your history stays honest and kind.
landing.why3Body: Private by default. Family see a weekly summary only if you invite them, and you can stop sharing instantly.
landing.why4Title: Made for everyday life in India
landing.why4Body: English, Hindi and Marathi — mixed is fine — with large text options and WhatsApp for days when an app feels like too much.
landing.safetyTitle: Clear about what Sukhi is, and what it isn't
landing.safetyBody: Sukhi supports a routine you have already agreed on. It doesn't diagnose, change doses, or replace your doctor.
landing.safetyIs1: A friendly reminder and check-in companion
landing.safetyIs2: A record of your routine that you share on your terms
landing.safetyIs3: A place to note questions for your next appointment
landing.safetyIsnt1: A medical device or an emergency service
landing.safetyIsnt2: A source of medicine changes or catch-up doses
landing.safetyIsnt3: A substitute for help — worrying symptoms are pointed straight to real care
landing.familyTitle: Family can cheer you on, on your terms
landing.familyBody: Invite a son, daughter or friend to see how your week went. They see participation only — never your chats, documents or medicines. Stop sharing whenever you want.
landing.q1: Do I need to download an app?
landing.a1: No. Sukhi works in your phone's browser and can be added to your home screen. You can also use it on WhatsApp once it's connected.
landing.a2: No. Sukhi helps you follow the plan your care team gave you. Questions about doses or symptoms always go to your doctor or pharmacist.
landing.a3: English, Hindi and Marathi, including a mix of them. You can change the language any time in Settings.
landing.a4: Only you. Your plan, messages and photos are private. If you invite family, they see a weekly summary and nothing more.
landing.q5: What happens if I miss a day?
landing.a5: Nothing is lost. Your garden never shrinks, and the next time you check in, Sukhi welcomes you back.
landing.ctaTitle: Start with one small step today
landing.ctaBody: Set up your plan in a few minutes. Sukhi takes care of the reminders.
landing.footerTagline: A gentle companion for the routine you agreed on.
landing.copyright: © {year} Sukhi. Not a medical device. In an emergency, call 112.

templates.walkDesc: A short walk each evening (personal goal).
templates.waterDesc: A glass of water at set times (personal goal).
templates.stretchDesc: Light stretches three times a week (personal goal).
templates.clinicianDesc: Type or upload what your care team gave you, then check each item.

status.no_response_help: We didn't hear back. This isn't counted as missed.

today.title: Today
today.unwellNote: Thank you for telling us. Rest matters. If you feel worse, please contact your doctor or call 112.

action.title: Action details
action.evidenceIntro: A photo or note helps your history. A photo can only show what is visible — it can't prove something was swallowed, eaten or how long it lasted.
action.outcome_supports: Supports the visible part of this action
action.outcome_does_not_support: Doesn't seem to match this action
action.method_model: Described automatically by AI (not a medical judgement)
action.notProbability: This is a description, not a score or proof.
action.selfReportNote: Self-reports and evidence are shown separately.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.empty: Ask about today's plan, tell me how it went, or just say “done”.
chat.transcriptConfirm: Check what I heard, edit if needed, then send.
chat.transcriptUncertain: I'm not fully sure I heard this right — especially names or numbers.
chat.micDenied: Microphone access is blocked. You can type instead, or allow the microphone in your browser settings.
chat.micUnsupported: Voice recording isn't supported in this browser. Please type instead.
chat.voiceUnavailable: Voice isn't available right now. Please type.
chat.voiceConsent: Voice is off. You can enable it in Settings.
chat.rateLimited: You're sending messages quickly. Please wait a moment.
chat.whatsappNote: Messages from WhatsApp appear here too.

plan.title: My plan
plan.empty: You don't have a plan yet.
plan.mode: What kind of plan is this?
plan.modeClinician: Instructions from my doctor or care team
plan.modeClinicianHelp: You transcribe them; Sukhi keeps the source and never treats your entry as clinician-verified.
plan.modePersonalHelp: A personal goal. It is not medical advice.
plan.noItems: No actions yet. Add one below or upload a document.
plan.sched_weekly_target: A number of days per week
plan.alternativesHint: Only fill this if your care team gave you alternatives.
plan.confirmHelp: Check this matches your source exactly. Confirming schedules reminders.
plan.editConfirmedWarning: Changing a confirmed action returns it to draft. You'll need to confirm it again before reminders resume.
plan.clinicalEditWarning: This came from your care team. Only change it to match their instructions — ask them before changing timing or frequency.
plan.unresolvedHelp: These fields couldn't be read clearly. Fill them in from your source before confirming. We never guess.
plan.markResolved: I've checked these against the source
plan.uploadHelp: We'll draft items for you to check. Nothing is scheduled until you confirm each one.
plan.extractUnavailable: Automatic reading isn't available right now. You can enter items manually.
plan.extractNoConsent: AI processing is off, so documents aren't read automatically. Enter items manually or enable it in Settings.
plan.extractFailed: We couldn't read this document. Please enter items manually.
plan.injectionWarning: This document contained text that looked like instructions to an AI. It was ignored. Please check every item carefully.

progress.title: Progress
progress.gardenRule: Your garden grows when you check in honestly and when you come back after a break. It never shrinks.
progress.goalHelp: Something small you'll treat yourself to — no money involved in Sukhi.
progress.goalDone: You reached your goal — enjoy it!

settings.title: Settings
settings.waNotConfigured: WhatsApp isn't configured for this Sukhi installation yet. Everything works in the web app.
settings.waPaused: Paused (reply START on WhatsApp to resume)
settings.waLinkIntro: To connect, create a code and send it from your WhatsApp to the Sukhi number. Codes expire in 15 minutes and work once.
settings.waWindowNote: Outside 24 hours after your last message, Sukhi can only send an approved generic notice like “Your Sukhi check-in is ready.”
settings.familyIntro: Share a weekly progress summary with someone you choose. They never see your chat, documents or plan details. You can stop sharing instantly.
settings.familyLink: Send this link to them (expires in 7 days):
settings.familyNoAutoMessages: Sukhi does not send automatic messages to family members.
settings.memoryIntro: Notes from your conversations. Confirm the ones that are right; reject anything wrong. These are not medical instructions.
settings.latency: Reminders are checked about once a minute. WhatsApp replies usually arrive within seconds and at most a couple of minutes.

family.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired, or has been withdrawn.
family.summaryIntro: Shared by them. Shows participation counts only.
family.revoked: Access to this summary has been withdrawn.

legal.draftNote: Pilot version, last updated 11 November 2026. This summary is under legal review.
legal.privacyIntro: Sukhi exists to help you keep a routine. We collect only what that needs, and you stay in control of it.
legal.pCollectBody: Your account email, the preferences you set, your plan, your check-ins, notes, photos and voice-note transcripts, and the messages you exchange with Sukhi.
legal.pUseBody: To schedule reminders, answer your questions from your own plan, show your progress, and keep an honest history. We don't sell your information or use it for advertising.
legal.pProcessorsBody: Supabase stores your data. If you allow it, Anthropic helps the assistant and photo descriptions, and Sarvam AI turns voice notes into text. If you connect WhatsApp, Meta delivers those messages.
legal.pFamilyBody: Nothing is shared unless you invite someone. Invited family see weekly participation counts only, and you can stop sharing at any time.
legal.pChoicesBody: Turn AI, voice, reminders, WhatsApp and family sharing on or off in Settings. You can delete your account and all its data from Settings at any time.
legal.termsIntro: By using Sukhi you agree to these terms.
legal.tWhatBody: Sukhi is a companion that helps you follow a routine you have agreed on with your care team or set for yourself. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.
legal.tCareBody: Always follow your doctor's instructions. Never change, skip or double medicines because of something in Sukhi. In an emergency, call 112 or your local emergency number.
legal.tAccountBody: Keep your login details private. Only enter information about yourself, or about someone who has asked you to help them.
legal.tUseBody: Don't misuse the service, try to access other people's information, or send harmful content.
legal.tChangesBody: Sukhi may change as we learn. We will tell you about important changes in the app.
